focus: Default-on integration needs, cost, and risk
noveltyJustification: Backend-transfer requirement, failure semantics, cost shape, and advisory-only blast radius are new; trust-debt carryover consolidates iteration 3.
keyQuestions: What would a default-on integration need (plumbing, hermeticity, budget), and what cost and risk does it carry?
answeredQuestions: What would a default-on integration need (plumbing, hermeticity, budget), and what cost and risk does it carry?

text: The keep covers the jev column only; the llm grader is a different implementation never measured by this arm; keep rule applies per backend column; wiring a jev kind is a later operator-opened phase (024 D5, spec out-of-scope).
A default-on grader must first gain an unmeasured/unavailable representation; today dispatch or parse failure becomes score 0.0 (max hallucination), deliberately left unchanged by 024 D1.
Defaults are hermetic (pattern, noop) and reports stamp scoringMethod+grader; default-on changes what every run measures and needs versioning plus re-baselining.

Family-collision guard refuses same-family llm grading without explicit override; jev gate skips without credential; default-on needs a stated independent grader model and a documented degraded mode, no silent mock fallback.

One grader call per scored output per uncached pass; harness cache (run-scoped, identity-keyed) makes repeats free; recorded jev reference 169 calls / ~93k est. tokens for 56 outputs; no per-run cost cap (fanout cost-unit guard is precedent).
The llm rubric scores against allowlist.cli_flags/symbols; all 21 fixtures carry none; populate before default-on or the grader runs anchorless.
Blast radius is advisory: the auto workflow can only recommend, cannot invoke promotion or create approval receipts (test asserts); outcome enum includes advisoryOnly.

Repeatability tolerance precedent (0.03, sub-tolerance deltas read as ties) already encodes single-sample noise concerns; a default-on D4 adds sampled noise to 15% of the weighted score and should get the same tie framing or multi-sample treatment.

Measurement trust debt (single-labeler labels, clustered rows, nominal significance, one hallucination family) would circulate at larger scale with default-on; the later phase should carry the Q3 fixes, not just wiring.
